title: goniopteris hondurensis

It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as skin conditions and inflammatory diseases. The therapeutic actions of Goniopteris hondurensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body.
